name: state-stock-shop-375
headings: H1: Four brines and a box.
H3: The everyday one — No. 01 HOUSE
H3: Mezcal, michelada, pork — No. 03 SMOKE

item.name: No. 01 HOUSE
item.description: Dill and Peppercorn Brine. The everyday one. Reach for it without thinking.

item.name: No. 02 DIRTY
item.description: Martini Brine. Built for the martini. Filtered clear so it will not cloud a stirred drink.

item.name: No. 03 SMOKE
item.description: Smoked Chilli Brine. Chipotle and manzano, smoked over manuka. Heat that arrives late.

item.name: No. 04 WILD
item.description: Coastal Brine. Kawakawa, kelp and lemon. For anything that came out of the sea.

item.name: The Full Set
item.description: All three, boxed.. Three bottles, one box, no decision required.
